# Country scope. Fast O(1) gate for independent fallback monthly pulse (rebel-guarded per fx17).
oe_mil_pulse_carrier = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = BYZ
        tag = ROM
        AND = { tag = CHI oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes }
        tag = RUS
        AND = {
            NOT = { country_exists = c:RUS }
            OR = { tag = MOS tag = NOV tag = KIE }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Upstream v8.0 Military Reform Read-Only Adapters
# All var:/global_var: reads strictly wrapped in trigger_if (zero POTENTIALGVAR / ORGUARD risk).
oe_mil_byz_v80_reformed = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_bem_mil_reformed
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_bem_mil_reformed }
                var:oe_bem_mil_reformed >= 1
            }
        }
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_bem_mil_reformed
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_mil_reformed }
                global_var:oe_bem_mil_reformed >= 1
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. True when a protagonist is in Age 5+ and has NOT completed firearm modernization.
oe_mil_needs_age5_modernization = {
    oe_mil_age_5_plus = yes
    OR = {
        AND = { oe_mil_is_byz_unit_host = yes NOT = { oe_mil_byz_firearm_reformed = yes } }
        AND = { oe_mil_is_yuan_unit_host = yes NOT = { oe_mil_yuan_firearm_reformed = yes } }
        AND = { oe_mil_is_rus_unit_host = yes NOT = { oe_mil_rus_firearm_reformed = yes } }
    }
}
